_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Manufacturing Technology Report
summary: The Manufacturing Technology Report details new or novel manufacturing methods, processes, and techniques in areas where the existing state-of-the-art does not meet military requirements.
description_purpose: The Manufacturing Technology Report details new or novel manufacturing methods, processes, and techniques in areas where the existing state-of-the-art does not meet military requirements.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID supersedes DI-MISC-81176.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: General.
preparation_instructions.content: The Manufacturing Technology Report shall be in one or more of the following forms, as specified in the contract:

children.title: Interim report
Pilot run report
Final report

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Manufacturing Methods Report format shall be contractor selected. Unless effective presentation would be degraded, the initially used format shall be used for all subsequent submissions.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Manufacturing Technology Report shall contain the following:

children.title: Material and process evaluations.
All process validations, to include methodologies.
All tests and the results, to include methodologies.
Equipment, material and process specifications.
Process flow diagrams and schematics.
Man loading.
Special handling techniques or requirements.
Drawings of unique tooling, fixtures, or equipment.
Quality control procedures.
Process cost analysis and end item(s) cost projections.
Cost to the Government, if any, of implementation, documentation and other recurring or nonrecurring costs.
Time required to implement the results of the Manufacturing Methods and Technology (MM&T) project into applicable facilities and production lines.
Identification of configuration end items and components to which the resulting technology would apply.
General survey of potential applications outside the contractor's facilities and products or production lines.
Analysis of the possible intended usage of special tooling equipment hardware or embedded computer software and modification and refurbishment cost.
Anticipated benefits for each configuration end item or group of end items for varying production rates.
Conclusions and recommendations.
Additional data necessary to provide a complete understanding and to support the narrative portion of the report.
children.content: These data may include diagrams, graphs, photographs, sketches, illustrations, computer printouts, etc.
